title: Classic Saudi Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Saudi dish made with chicken, keen, and Arabian spices, slow-cooked in a flavorful tagine.

ingredients.name: Arabian spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: traditional clay pot or Dutch oven

instructions: Heat oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Arabian spices, keen, and water to the tagine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with flatbread.
